conviction_note: Small and positive because the load-bearing find here is a magnitude constraint rather than a direction: three Form 425 business-combination communications in the month before the print, plus a shareholder meeting notice, mean this bank is mid-transaction with registered securities, and a print delivered into a live stock deal is anchored to the deal rather than to the quarter - consistent with a baseline median reaction of only 0.82% and a maximum of 1.53%.

findings.finding: VersaBank filed Form 425 business-combination communications on 2026-07-28, 2026-08-05 and 2026-08-25, each paired with a 6-K the same day or the day before, and distributed a notice of meeting and proxy materials to shareholders on 2026-08-24 - i.e. a securities-registered transaction requiring a shareholder vote is live across the entire run-in to this print.
findings.corpus_ref: filings.json, Form 425 entries dated 2026-08-25, 2026-08-05 and 2026-07-28 with 6-Ks alongside each; docs/f2233c222cdecfd599d1e0f50b9cac4e2c71cfed.txt entry dated 2026-08-24T23:24:29Z ('distributed a notice of meeting and proxy materials to shareholders')
findings.why_not_priced: No news search was run for this ticker (n_queries=0 in every admissible sweep) and the entire admissible social stream is three messages, one of which is a bare link - a shareholder writes on 2026-08-21 'I am pretty excited for earnings but I think I am the only one'. A Form 425 is the least-read filing type there is, and three of them in a month at a 93,825-share-a-day bank is an unaggregated fact. Its consequence is directional only weakly - deal progress is mildly positive - but it is strongly informative about magnitude: the quarter cannot move a stock whose price is set by exchange terms, which is why I am near the bottom of the distribution rather than at the median.
findings.independence: The company also filed 6-Ks on 2026-08-24, 08-25 (twice), 08-26 and 09-01 - an unusually dense filing cadence for a bank - which corroborates that something transactional rather than routine is in progress: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001690639&type=6-K

searched_and_found_nothing: the identity or terms of the transaction: no 425 body, no 6-K body and no news item names a counterparty, so I know a registered business combination exists and nothing about it
any 13D, activist filing or insider Form 4 - as a Canadian issuer VersaBank's insider trades are on SEDI, not EDGAR
any equity or debt issuance separate from the 425 registration
any consensus estimate, sell-side preview, credit-asset growth or net-interest-margin datapoint: n_queries=0 in every admissible sweep
any explanation for the stock being 18.7% below its 52-week high while up 71% from the low
baseline_tension: It sits with the run-in, which is essentially flat (-2.7% over five sessions, -0.4% over twenty), and with the baseline's own tiny 0.82% median reaction; the finding explains that median rather than contradicting it.
corpus_limits: No option chain, so no implied move or skew. No news search was run for this ticker; no 425 or 6-K body is stored, so the transaction at the centre of this hunt is visible only as a form type. The baseline's reaction history is unusable (1-day inferred cadence, verdict 'unknown') and I did not use it as a base rate beyond noting that no tagged move exceeded 1.53%.
